chunks: Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام said: “None of you should drink medicine on Thursday.”
So it was said: “O Amir al-Mu'minin, and why is that?” He said: “So that he does not become weakened from attending the Jumu'ah.”

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: The title of Imam Ali عليه السلام, meaning Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.إِتْيَانِ الْجُمُعَةِ: going to or attending the Friday congregational prayer

ai.seo_question: Why did Amir al-Mu'minin Imam Ali عليه السلام discourage taking medicine on Thursday?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs against taking medicine on Thursday if it may weaken a person from attending the Friday congregation. Its significance lies in emphasizing care for preserving one's ability to perform an important communal act of worship.
